sql_text: SELECT c.customer_id, c.region FROM (SELECT customer_id, region FROM `demo.sales.customers`) AS c
SELECT c.customer_id, o.order_id FROM `demo.sales.customers` AS c JOIN (SELECT customer_id, order_id FROM `demo.sales.orders`) AS o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
SELECT c.customer_id, p.plan_name FROM `demo.sales.customers` AS c LEFT JOIN (SELECT customer_id, plan_name FROM `demo.sales.plans`) AS p ON p.customer_id = c.customer_id
SELECT a.id, b.id FROM (SELECT id FROM `demo.analytics.left_source`) AS a CROSS JOIN (SELECT id FROM `demo.analytics.right_source`) AS b
SELECT * FROM (SELECT * FROM (SELECT customer_id FROM `demo.sales.customers`) AS inner_rows) AS outer_rows
SELECT x.customer_id FROM (SELECT customer_id FROM (SELECT customer_id FROM `demo.sales.orders`) AS staged) AS x
SELECT id FROM (SELECT id FROM `demo.sales.current_orders`) AS current_rows UNION ALL SELECT id FROM (SELECT id FROM `demo.sales.archive_orders`) AS archived_rows
WITH source_rows AS (SELECT * FROM (SELECT customer_id FROM `demo.sales.customers`) AS c) SELECT customer_id FROM source_rows
WITH regions AS (SELECT region FROM `demo.sales.regions`), enriched AS (SELECT * FROM (SELECT customer_id, region FROM regions) AS r) SELECT * FROM enriched

WITH customers AS (SELECT * FROM (SELECT customer_id FROM `demo.sales.customers`) AS c), orders AS (SELECT * FROM (SELECT order_id, customer_id FROM `demo.sales.orders`) AS o) SELECT * FROM customers JOIN orders USING (customer_id)
WITH active_customers AS (SELECT customer_id FROM `demo.sales.customers`) SELECT * FROM active_customers JOIN (SELECT customer_id FROM `demo.sales.orders`) AS o USING (customer_id)
CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE `demo.marts.customer_orders` AS SELECT * FROM (SELECT customer_id, order_id FROM `demo.sales.orders`) AS o
CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW `demo.marts.active_customers` AS SELECT * FROM (SELECT customer_id FROM `demo.sales.customers` WHERE active) AS c
CREATE TEMP TABLE recent_orders AS SELECT * FROM (SELECT order_id, order_date FROM `demo.sales.orders` WHERE order_date >= DATE '2025-01-01') AS recent
INSERT INTO `demo.marts.order_summary` (customer_id, order_count) SELECT customer_id, COUNT(*) FROM (SELECT customer_id FROM `demo.sales.orders`) AS o GROUP BY customer_id

MERGE `demo.marts.customers` AS target USING (SELECT customer_id, email FROM `demo.sales.customer_updates`) AS source ON target.customer_id = source.customer_id WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET email = source.email WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT (customer_id, email) VALUES (source.customer_id, source.email)
UPDATE `demo.marts.customers` AS target SET region = source.region FROM (SELECT customer_id, region FROM `demo.sales.region_updates`) AS source WHERE target.customer_id = source.customer_id
SELECT c.customer_id FROM `demo.sales.customers` AS c WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM (SELECT customer_id FROM `demo.sales.orders`) AS o WHERE o.customer_id = c.customer_id)
WITH customers AS (SELECT customer_id FROM `demo.sales.customers`) SELECT * FROM (SELECT customer_id FROM customers) AS c WHERE customer_id IN (SELECT customer_id FROM `demo.sales.vip_customers`)
SELECT customer_id, order_id FROM (SELECT customer_id, order_id, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY order_date DESC) AS rn FROM `demo.sales.orders`) AS ranked WHERE rn = 1
SELECT region, order_count FROM (SELECT region, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM `demo.sales.orders` GROUP BY region) AS totals HAVING order_count > 10
SELECT c.customer_id, item FROM `demo.sales.customers` AS c JOIN (SELECT customer_id, items FROM `demo.sales.order_arrays`) AS o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id, UNNEST(o.items) AS item

SELECT * FROM (SELECT customer_id FROM `demo.sales.customers`) AS c JOIN (SELECT customer_id FROM `demo.sales.orders`) AS o USING (customer_id) LEFT JOIN (SELECT customer_id FROM `demo.sales.support_cases`) AS s USING (customer_id)

WITH first_batch AS (SELECT id FROM (SELECT id FROM `demo.events.batch_one`) AS b), second_batch AS (SELECT id FROM (SELECT id FROM `demo.events.batch_two`) AS b) SELECT id FROM first_batch UNION ALL SELECT id FROM second_batch
CREATE TABLE `demo.marts.daily_orders` PARTITION BY order_date AS SELECT * FROM (SELECT order_id, order_date FROM `demo.sales.orders`) AS o

config { type: "table" }
SELECT c.customer_id FROM ${ref("customers")} AS c JOIN (SELECT customer_id FROM ${ref("orders")}) AS o USING (customer_id)

config { type: "view" }
SELECT * FROM (SELECT customer_id FROM ${ref("customers")}) AS c

config { type: "table" }
SELECT * FROM (SELECT customer_id FROM ${ref("customers")}) AS c WHERE ${when(incremental(), "customer_id > 100", "TRUE")}

config { type: "incremental", uniqueKey: ["customer_id"] }
SELECT * FROM (SELECT * FROM (SELECT customer_id FROM ${ref("customers")}) AS base) AS staged

config { type: "table" }
SELECT c.customer_id, o.order_id FROM ${ref("customers")} AS c LEFT JOIN (SELECT customer_id, order_id FROM ${ref("orders")}) AS o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE c.customer_id IN (SELECT customer_id FROM ${ref("vip_customers")})

config { type: "table" }
WITH source_rows AS (SELECT * FROM (SELECT customer_id FROM ${ref("customers")}) AS c) SELECT * FROM source_rows JOIN (SELECT customer_id FROM ${ref("orders")}) AS o USING (customer_id)
